meta.name: Agent Policy Index
meta.method: Every entry comes from a real contribution campaign run in October 2026: issues claimed, PRs opened, bots and policies met face to face, plus Greenlight friction measurements. Policy classes marked 'detected' were found by automated scans; classes marked 'verified' were confirmed by a policy file read or by direct campaign contact.

classes.label: Agent contributions banned
classes.meaning: The repo's agent policy forbids autonomous agent contributions and AI-drafted PR text. Do not submit there with an agent.

classes.label: AI disclosure required
classes.meaning: Agents may contribute, but the repo requires AI involvement to be disclosed in titles, bodies, and release notes.

classes.label: Assignment required
classes.meaning: You must be assigned the issue by a maintainer before work counts. Unassigned PRs may be auto-closed.

classes.label: Claim first
classes.meaning: Comment on the issue to claim it before you start. Silent starts lose races.

classes.label: Triage hold
classes.meaning: Issues in triage are not ready to build on. Wait until the triage labels clear.

classes.label: Outside PRs paused
classes.meaning: The repo has structurally paused or auto-closes external pull requests. Do not target it.

classes.label: Maintainer-only PRs
classes.meaning: External PRs are not accepted. The contribution is a detailed, verified issue comment.

classes.label: Collaborators-only PRs
classes.meaning: Only collaborators can open PRs. Outside fork-based PRs are rejected or never land.

classes.label: Vouch required
classes.meaning: A maintainer must vouch for you (or you must join a contributor list) before your PR survives.

classes.label: CLA required
classes.meaning: A Contributor License Agreement signature is required before merge. Find the exact path, it is fragmented across repos.

classes.label: DCO sign-off required
classes.meaning: Every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer. Unsigned commits fail the gate.

classes.label: Discussion first
classes.meaning: Open an issue or discussion and get agreement before you build, especially for new features.

classes.label: Bot-gated intake
classes.meaning: A bot triages incoming work with labels like needs-product-decision. Claims are fine; PRs wait for a human signal.

classes.label: Open to agent-assisted PRs
classes.meaning: No structural gate found against agent-assisted contributions. Standard contribution rules still apply.
